job.name: credleakscan
job.script:
#!/bin/bash
echo "Scanning for leaked credentials..."
if [ -z "$REPO_ROOT" ]; then echo "ERROR: REPO_ROOT environment variable is not set." exit 1 fi
if [ ! -d "$REPO_ROOT" ]; then echo "ERROR: REPO_ROOT is not a valid directory." exit 1 fi
REPO_ROOT="$(realpath "$REPO_ROOT")" echo "Starting credential scan in $REPO_ROOT"
RESULTS_FILE="$(mktemp)"
scan_for_credentials() { echo "Scanning for API keys, tokens, and credentials..."
# Common patterns for credentials # Look for common credential patterns in code files grep -r -E "(api_?key|flag|apikey|secret|token|password|passwd|pwd|credentials|creds|auth)" \ --include="*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx,py,rb,php,java,go,sh,json,yaml,yml,ini,conf,env,txt,md}" \ --exclude-dir={node_modules,vendor,.git,dist,build} "$REPO_ROOT" | tee -a "$RESULTS_FILE" || true
# AWS keys grep -r -E "(AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16})" \ --include="*" --exclude-dir={node_modules,vendor,.git,dist,build} "$REPO_ROOT" | tee -a "$RESULTS_FILE" || true
# Private keys grep -r -E "BEGIN.*PRIVATE KEY" \ --include="*" --exclude-dir={node_modules,vendor,.git,dist,build} "$REPO_ROOT" | tee -a "$RESULTS_FILE" || true
# Connection strings grep -r -E "(mongodb|postgresql|mysql|redis|jdbc)://[a-zA-Z0-9_]+:[a-zA-Z0-9_!-]+@" \ --include="*" --exclude-dir={node_modules,vendor,.git,dist,build} "$REPO_ROOT" | tee -a "$RESULTS_FILE" || true
# OAuth tokens grep -r -E "(gh[pousr]_[0-9a-zA-Z]{36}|github_pat_[0-9a-zA-Z_]{82})" \ --include="*" --exclude-dir={node_modules,vendor,.git,dist,build} "$REPO_ROOT" | tee -a "$RESULTS_FILE" || true
# Environment files grep -r -E "^[A-Za-z0-9_]+=.+" --include=".env*" "$REPO_ROOT" | tee -a "$RESULTS_FILE" || true }
scan_for_credentials
if [ -s "$RESULTS_FILE" ]; then FINDINGS_COUNT=$(cat "$RESULTS_FILE" | wc -l) echo "WARNING: Found $FINDINGS_COUNT potential credential leaks!" echo "Review the findings above and remove any sensitive information." echo "reject" | tee /pr-status/status exit 1 else echo 'No credential leaks found in {%= app_name %}' fi
